compatibility_findings: Frozen completion question heads are truncated to 167 tokens, dropping their core question tails. Checker input is compromised even when state fits.
Each question has 316 state tokens available. Native /api/decide prefix-truncates a longer state and reports state_truncated:true.
state_truncated reports state loss only, not question instruction-head truncation. A false value does not prove the whole completion check was read.
Unchanged Proceda rejects state_truncated:true or an absent/non-false truncation flag and abstains regardless of decision threshold 0.8.
The existing 18000-character guard does not establish fit inside a 512-token model context.
No prompts, inputs, context windows, completion logic, source, benchmark code, tests, or experiment configurations were changed by this preflight.
